summary: Harmony Gold Mining furnished a Form 6-K disclosing dealings in securities by directors and prescribed officers under JSE Listings Requirements 6.77-6.80. Deferred share awards under the Harmony Deferred Share Plan 2018 vested 18 September 2026 and were settled 2 October 2026 via on-market sales at a volume-weighted average price of R290.4505 per share (range R287.00-R295.29). CEO BB Nel sold 124,064 shares for R36.0m; FD BP Lekubo sold 75,919 for R22.1m; other officers also sold. This is a routine equity-settlement notice, not a special situation.
